components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-button-primary{font-family:var(--font-sans,"Plus Jakarta Sans",system-ui,sans-serif);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:42px;padding:10px 16px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:var(--radius-sm,8px);background:var(--action,#252b31);color:var(--paper,#fff);font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;font-weight:550;cursor:pointer;} .ds-button-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--green,#326652);outline-offset:3px;} .ds-button-primary:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:default;} .ds-button-primary:active:not(:disabled){opacity:.8;} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-button-primary{transition:background-color var(--motion-fast,140ms) ease;} .ds-button-primary:active:not(:disabled){translate:0 1px;}} @media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.ds-button-primary:hover:not(:disabled){background:#3b4249;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm,0 2px 4px #18232e05);}}

components.html: <nav class="ds-nav" aria-label="Workspace"><button class="ds-nav-item ds-nav-active" aria-current="page">Home</button><button class="ds-nav-item">Sales</button><button class="ds-nav-item">Trip</button></nav>

components.css: .ds-card{font-family:var(--font-sans,"Plus Jakarta Sans",system-ui,sans-serif);padding:14px;border:1px solid #e2e7ed;border-radius:10px;background:var(--paper,#fff);color:var(--ink,#242a30);box-shadow:0 2px 3px #18232e03;} .ds-card-tag{display:inline-block;margin-bottom:8px;padding:3px 7px;border-radius:5px;color:var(--muted,#626b74);background:#f0f2f4;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.5;} .ds-card-title{font-family:var(--font-sans,"Plus Jakarta Sans",system-ui,sans-serif);display:block;text-align:left;padding:0;border:0;background:transparent;color:inherit;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.5;letter-spacing:-.02em;cursor:pointer;} .ds-card-title:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--green,#326652);outline-offset:3px;} .ds-card-facts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.35fr) minmax(0,1fr);margin-top:12px;padding:10px 0;gap:8px;border-block:1px solid #edf0f4;} .ds-card-facts>div+div{border-left:1px solid #e6ebef;padding-left:12px;} .ds-card-facts small{display:block;color:var(--muted,#626b74);font-size:12px;margin-bottom:4px;} .ds-card-facts span{font-size:12px;font-weight:550;} @media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.ds-card:hover{border-color:#cbd2d9;box-shadow:var(--shadow-raised,0 6px 16px #18232e0a);} .ds-card-title:hover{color:var(--green,#326652);}}

narrative.overview:
The workspace presents operational information on a cool neutral canvas with white work surfaces, charcoal actions, and quiet semantic color. A floating labelled navigation panel, open columns, grouped facts, and shared metric strips make context and work easy to skim. Plus Jakarta Sans supplies both headings and working text.

The visual system describes the implemented October 26, 2026 redesign. Preserve travelOS, Egimu Travel, and the existing brand image at `public/brand/egimu-logo.jpg`. Existing routes, actions, forms, permission boundaries, financial meanings, and recovery behavior remain authoritative. See PRODUCT.md for product constraints and the surface brief for the approved direction; this document records reusable visual rules.

Home uses three Kanban columns with compact task items, not a task table. Five displayed fields: title, note, due date, source, status. Task padding12px/radius8px; journey cards padding14px/radius10px. Existing interaction handlers remain.

Public Share Trip: centered1080px shell,24px outer padding, branded white header, horizontally scrollable tabs, clear published facts, flat itinerary/Notes and consistent modal fields. Phones use12px outer gutters. No private stage IDs are displayed.

Consolas, monospace remains reserved for the existing raw Markdown source field; UI uses Plus Jakarta Sans.
keyCharacteristics: Cool neutral canvas and white work surfaces.
Charcoal actions with restrained semantic sage, blue, and amber.
Readable facts and metadata grouped by meaning.
Flat surfaces with fine outlines and quiet interaction feedback.
The same operational capabilities across desktop and narrow screens.

rules.name: The Semantic Accent Rule
rules.body: Use accent color to communicate data, state, focus, or an existing link; keep everyday navigation and primary actions neutral.

rules.name: The Grouped Facts Rule
rules.body: Keep each record's facts visually together, with labels close to values and existing controls clearly separated from descriptive content.

dos: Do preserve existing actions, routes, form behavior, permissions, and data meanings while styling new surfaces.
Do group related facts and metrics within shared outlined surfaces.
Do keep semantic color paired with readable text labels.
Do retain visible keyboard focus, reduced-motion behavior, and responsive overflow affordances.
Do preserve the existing Egimu Travel brand image and travelOS identity.
donts: Don't introduce extra workflow steps, KPIs, or product controls as decoration; use existing content and actions.
Don't replace the implemented composition with uniformly boxed columns; keep board columns open and group the records themselves.
Don't compress native date fields below their usable track; keep the narrow-screen stacking rules.
